raw.details:
Challenge Instructions

Create an attractive and original promotional post for SkillInf highlighting its internships, skill development programs, practical learning, and career opportunities.They provide the internships domains such as AI, Data Science, Web Development, Cybersecurity, UI/UX, Digital Marketing, Programming, and Automation.

What You Have to Do

  • Create one promotional image/post for SkillInf.
  • Include the official SkillInf logo in your design.
  • Publish the created post on your LinkedIn profile.
  • Add the SkillInf website in your post: https://www.skillinf.in/
  • Add relevant hashtags, such as #SkillInf #LearnBuildGrow #Internship #SkillDevelopment #Students #CareerGrowth.
  • Keep your LinkedIn post public.
  • After publishing, take a screenshot of your LinkedIn post analytics showing the impressions/reach.

What You Need to Submit

  • Your created promotional image
  • LinkedIn post link
  • Screenshot of LinkedIn impressions/analytics

Design Requirements

  • Recommended size: 1200 × 627 px
  • Use the official SkillInf logo
  • Make the post creative, attractive, and professional.
  • The content should promote SkillInf accurately.
  • You can use Canva, Photoshop, AI tools, or any other design tool.

Important Rules

  • The post must be your own original creation.
  • Do not use fake accounts, bots, or paid/fake engagement to increase impressions.
  • The LinkedIn post must remain public during the evaluation period.
  • LinkedIn impressions are only one part of the evaluation. Creativity, design, content, and how effectively you promote SkillInf will also be considered.

Create → Post → Promote → Submit

Learn. Build. Grow. — SkillInf

The 1st Prize Winner will receive:

  • Internship Opportunity at SkillInf
  • Job Opportunity at SkillInf for the role of Digital Marketing, based on the organization's requirements and the candidate's suitability.All the participant receive the participation cetificates.
